title: Quenched Russian Pillowy Breads Bowl
description: Indulge in this salty, pillowy Russian dish featuring thyme, made using an anti-inflammatory-friendly recipe and served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Combine the warm water and yeast in a large bowl.
Let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated.
Add the flour, salt, sugar, and thyme to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on the desired size.
Shape each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Fry the dough disks in the preheated oil for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and puffed.
Drain the fried dough on paper towels and serve warm in a Korean brass bowl, quenched with a sprinkle of thyme and flaxseed meal.
